attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ae_004
steps:
  - id: retrieve_csrf_token
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: GET
      url: "{{cms_base_url}}/session/token"
      headers:
        Accept: text/plain
    output: csrf_token

  - id: authenticate_publisher
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      method: session
      credentials:
        username: "{{publishing_user}}"
        password: "{{publishing_password}}"
      csrf_token: "{{csrf_token}}"
    output: auth_session

  - id: validate_article_payload
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      schema: cms_article_schema
      data: "{{article_payload}}"
    output: validation_result

  - id: create_paragraph_blocks
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{article_payload.content_sections}}"
      step:
        id: create_block
        op: call_webhook
        params:
          method: POST
          url: "{{cms_base_url}}/jsonapi/paragraph/content_block"
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json
            X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
            Cookie: "{{auth_session.session_cookie}}"
          body:
            data:
              type: paragraph--content_block
              attributes:
                field_body:
                  value: "{{item.html}}"
                  format: full_html
    output: paragraph_blocks

  - id: extract_block_uuids
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{paragraph_blocks}}"
      field: data.id
    output: block_uuids

  - id: create_article_node
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "{{cms_base_url}}/jsonapi/node/article"
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json
        X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
        Cookie: "{{auth_session.session_cookie}}"
      body:
        data:
          type: node--article
          attributes:
            title: "{{article_payload.title}}"
            field_summary: "{{article_payload.summary}}"
            field_category: "{{article_payload.category}}"
            field_tags: "{{article_payload.tags}}"
          relationships:
            field_content_blocks:
              data: "{{block_uuids}}"
    output: article_node

  - id: validate_article_creation
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      schema: cms_article_response_schema
      data: "{{article_node}}"
      rules:
        - field: data.id
          condition: exists
        - field: data.attributes.status
          condition: equals
          value: true
    output: creation_validation

  - id: audit_log_entry
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: article_published
      details:
        article_title: "{{article_payload.title}}"
        node_id: "{{article_node.data.id}}"
        timestamp: "{{now}}"
        published_by: "{{publishing_user}}"
